messages:
olivia_support: Hi - CorpX (org_id: org_87JZ) reported their daily usage CSV export appears to be split across day boundaries. They expect daily buckets in America/Los_Angeles but CSV looks like UTC buckets. Can someone take a look?

sam_eng: Can you paste the CSV head and the exact export query you used? Also confirm the org timezone setting.

olivia_support: Org timezone is `America/Los_Angeles`. Export call we used: `GET /v1/usage/export?org=org_87JZ&from=2025-06-01&to=2025-06-02&tz=org` CSV sample pasted by customer:

```
date,org_id,model,tokens
2025-06-01,org_87JZ,gpt-4o,1200
2025-06-02,org_87JZ,gpt-4o,300
```

They say the 300 tokens are from 2025-06-01T23:50:00-07:00 (PDT), i.e. should be counted on 2025-06-01 for their org.

maria_billing: Sounds like the aggregation pipeline rolled at UTC. Billing/UI historically use org.timezone but the offline rollup job may be defaulting to UTC. Did anything change in the rollup deployment last week? :thinking:

metrics-bot: alert: daily-aggregation job executed with TZ=UTC for window 2025-06-01 (run id: agg-20250601-22). Logs: /ops/logs/agg-20250601.log

eli_prod: I reproduced this locally. The rollup job CLI accepts `--tz` and the k8s CronJob relied on env var `ROLLUP_TZ`. Recent helm change removed that env var so the binary fell back to `UTC`. Repro steps: 
1) `./bin/rollup --start 2025-06-01 --end 2025-06-02 --tz UTC`
2) `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/export?org=org_87JZ&from=2025-06-01&to=2025-06-02&tz=org" > out.csv`
Observed: bucket boundary was at 00:00Z rather than 00:00 America/Los_Angeles.

sam_eng: Thanks. Can eng-infra add the env back and schedule a backfill? I'll open an infra ticket and mark high priority (INFR-842).

maria_billing: Short-term workaround for CorpX: have them re-run export with explicit tz param: `?tz=America/Los_Angeles` — that should yield the expected rows until we backfill.

sam_eng: Created INFR-842 (https://redwood-internal/issue/INFR-842). Assigned to @eli_prod. Plan: (1) restore ROLLUP_TZ in CronJob, (2) run backfill migration for affected windows, (3) add a CI check to ensure env var present.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: rollup-cronjob env update v2 -> staging at 2025-06-10T03:00Z, prod at 2025-06-11T03:00Z.

eli_prod: Working on PR to default to reading org timezone when `tz=org` in export and to fail loudly if rollup job has no tz. Also adding a backfill script: `scripts/backfill_rollups --start 2025-06-01 --end 2025-06-07 --tz America/Los_Angeles`.

olivia_support: Told customer we'll backfill and re-run their export, ETA ~48 hours. Provided workaround to run export with explicit tz param.

maria_billing: Will follow up to verify billing tiles and dashboard charts match the backfilled data once job completes.

olivia_support: Closing loop with CorpX after backfill. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
